# Kyle Tse

> Kyle Tse is the founder of Sylphx, a software company that runs on AI agents.

This is Kyle Tse's personal site, with his work, companies and background.
The links below lead to his site, products and public GitHub profile.

## Personal site and profile

- [Kyle Tse](https://kylet.se/): Work, companies and background.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/shtse8): Kyle Tse's public GitHub profile.

## Sylphx and products

- [Sylphx](https://sylphx.com): Hosting, Postgres, Auth, AI and Sandboxes behind one key and one bill.
- [Spiron](https://spiron.ai): An AI agent that finishes a job and returns the result with proof.
- [Keel Engine](https://keelengine.dev): One Rust engine for games, apps and websites.
